astra_quota_truth.conclusion: Account-specific applied quotas can contradict AWS defaults and model availability metadata; Service Quotas could not request a value below or equal to the AWS default.

durable_lessons: Never equate ListFoundationModels/GetFoundationModelAvailability authorization metadata with executable runtime availability.
A model becomes routable only after an actual provider invocation canary succeeds under the production identity path.
Provider catalog discovery and runtime admission are separate states; preserve discovered inventory while fail-closing routing.
Model-attested ChatGPT workers must not self-certify their model identity; keep Astra worker routing disabled until independently attested.
Account-specific quota values and provider onboarding gates must be read back separately from AWS defaults.
When live provider truth contradicts planned configuration, preserve evidence, fail closed, and make the hold canonical in GitHub rather than leaving an out-of-band hotfix.
